title: Debate Transcript
description: Structured record of an adversarial multi-agent debate from Phase D. Contains all agent arguments, evidence citations, proposed changes, and the synthesizer's final decisions. The refined artifact (updated knowledge-overview or design-spec) is produced as a separate output alongside this transcript.

input_id.description: ID of the artifact being debated (overview_id or spec_id)

input_version.description: Version of the artifact before debate

output_version.description: Version of the refined artifact after debate

codebase_requirements_id.description: ID of codebase-requirements used as context during debate (if any)

kb_queries_used.description: Whether knowledge base queries were made during this debate

type.description: Divergent: agents analyze independently in parallel. Convergent: synthesizer resolves.

position.description: The agent's primary argument or assessment

evidence.description: Source item IDs, KB query results, or codebase references supporting the position

counterpoints.description: Specific counterarguments to other positions or to the current artifact

proposed_changes.description: Concrete changes recommended to the artifact

changes_accepted.description: Changes incorporated into the refined artifact, with brief rationale

proposed.description: The proposed change that was rejected

reason.description: Why the synthesizer rejected this change

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that may require additional research or human decision
